answer: Require every voting agent to lock a slashable stake for a full epoch before its attestation counts. Honest voters reclaim the deposit plus a fee; anyone caught signing two conflicting attestations or trading votes with a twin forfeits it. Sybil resistance becomes arithmetic: controlling a tenth of the council needs a tenth of the total bond, so a thousand fake wallets require a thousand deposits, not one. A false identity becomes a narrow ledge - one slip and the bond is gone. Even a sparrow-sized microagent must risk capital; losing its saffron earnings makes collusion a losing trade.
